title: With paying online when joining switched on, the owner's help and the AI help still say people who join online pay at the desk, not online
what: Paying online on the join page is live. The owner's help article about the join link, which is always shown and which the AI help answers from, still says 'They pay at the desk, not online' and to tap 'Make member'. The newer article next to it says they can pay online and the owner taps Approve. The gym web page's AI chat is also told 'then pays at the gym' for every gym. So an owner asking the help box can get the old answer, and the two articles contradict each other.
expected: While paying online when joining is on, the help article and the AI help say that people can pay online when the gym has it switched on, and point to Approve; 'pay at the desk' only when it is off.
how_often: every time an owner reads join help or asks the AI help about joining online
fix_line: Show the old join article only while paying online when joining is off, or reword it to cover both, and tell the page chat when the gym takes join payments online

title: Two payment requests for the same due or join request can be made if two asks land at the same moment
what: Before making a payment request, the server looks for an open one for the same due (or join request) and amount, and makes a new one only if none is found. Nothing in the payment table stops a second one, so two asks at the same moment (the owner's phone and the desk computer, or two browser tabs on the join page) can each make their own request and payment link. The page's button is greyed while sending, so one tab alone is safe.
expected: Only one open payment request per due or join request and amount, even when two asks arrive together.
how_often: rare: only when two asks for the same due arrive together
fix_line: Add a database rule allowing one open request per gym, kind, reference and amount, and reuse the existing one when the insert is refused
